  "pros": [
    "Enabled data-driven decision making with highly customizable dashboards for marketing initiatives.",
    "Provided a consistent and reliable single source of truth for business metrics across the organization.",
    "Facilitated easy data exploration and sharing among different teams, empowering self-service analytics."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "The initial setup and learning curve for LookML modeling was quite steep.",
    "Performance could sometimes be slow when dealing with extremely large datasets or complex queries.",
    "The cost can be a significant investment for a mid-sized company, requiring careful ROI justification."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Senior Digital Innovation Manager found Looker to be an invaluable tool for driving data-driven strategies within their marketing and advertising company for over two years. They appreciated its powerful data modeling capabilities and the ability to create highly customized, reliable dashboards. While acknowledging the initial complexity and cost, the consistent insights and analytical empowerment it offered made it a strong asset."
